formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : SimpleGraph (Fin (11 : ℕ))) [x2 : DecidableRel x1.Adj] (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   x1 = PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.edgeGraph (11 : ℕ) [((0 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (4 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (6 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((7 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((8 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ))] →     PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO x1 x3 →       PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm x1 x3 →         have x7 : Finset ℕ := PEqualNP.TopForm.tops x1 x3;         have x8 : Finset ℕ := PEqualNP.TopForm.centreless x1 x3;         have x9 : Finset ℕ := PEqualNP.TopForm.junk x1 x3;         have x10 : Finset (Sym2 (Fin (11 : ℕ))) := PEqualNP.TopForm.Ustar x1 x3;         (∀ x11 ∈ x7,             have x13 : Fin (2 : ℕ) → Finset (Fin (11 : ℕ)) := PEqualNP.TopForm.side x3 x11;             (∀ x14 ∈ x13 (0 : Fin (2 : ℕ)), ∀ x16 ∈ x13 (1 : Fin (2 : ℕ)), x1.Adj x14 x16) ∧ ((x13 (0 : Fin (2 : ℕ))).card ≤ (1 : ℕ) ∨ (x13 (1 : Fin (2 : ℕ))).card ≤ (1 : ℕ))) →           (∀ (x12 x13 : Fin (11 : ℕ)), s(x12, x13) ∈ x10 → ∃ x15 ∈ x7, ∃ (x16 : Fin (2 : ℕ)), ∃ x17 ∈ x9, PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal (11 : ℕ) x3 x15 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput x12 x13) = Bool.true ∧ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches (11 : ℕ) x3 (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd x3 x15 x16) x17 ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal (11 : ℕ) x3 x17 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput x12 x13) = Bool.true) → (15 : ℕ) + (x7 \ x8).card + (2 : ℕ) * x8.card + x9.card + (PEqualNP.TopForm.orN x1 x3 \ PEqualNP.TopForm.lam x1 x3).card ≤ x3.size + x10.card → (∀ (x14 : Finset (Fin (11 : ℕ))), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover (x1.deleteEdges ↑x10) x14 → x14.card ≤ (x7 \ x8).card) → (3 : ℕ) ≤ x9.card → (22 : ℕ) ≤ x3.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: G11 (edges 0-9, 0-10, 1-4, 1-8, 2-5, 2-10, 3-6, 3-7, 4-8, 4-10, 5-8, 5-9, 6-7, 6-10, 7-9, 8-9): every least top-form fan-in-exactly-two AND/OR circuit for its edge function, whose tops have fully adjacent sides with one side of size <= 1, whose U* edges are each true at a top and at a junk AND OR-reached from one of its operands, and whose min cover of G minus U* is at most the tops with a centre, with 15 + (tops with centre) + 2 (centreless) + junk + (orN minus lam) <= size + |U*| and at least 3 junk ANDs, has at least 22 gates.
